text: Atlas is operated by the Platform Reliability team. The service handles authentication traffic.
Platform Reliability maintains the Borealis storage system and several internal deployment services.
Borealis performs full backups every Sunday. Incremental backups run every six hours.
Atlas deployment snapshots are created once per day for rollback support.
Developer Productivity maintains the Cirrus worker platform and build tooling.
Atlas Analytics is operated by the Developer Productivity team. It produces internal reporting dashboards.
Platform Reliability previously maintained the Aurora storage system before it was retired.
Borealis full backups run every Sunday and are retained for thirty days.
Cirrus incremental backups run every four hours for worker-state recovery.
